products.product_description: Wegmans Peach Salsa, made fresh in-store and packaged in random weights.
products.reason_for_recall: Wegmans Food Markets, Inc. voluntarily recalled fresh individually sold, bagged and sliced fresh plums, nectarines and peaches, peach salsa, and several in-store baked desserts that may contain fresh peaches, nectarines, and/or plums. The fruit may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
